title: Answer: space is extension that occasions atomize

statements.text: Space belongs to the extensive continuum, the general scheme of real potentiality for relations, which actual occasions atomize. Every actual entity in the temporal world has a spatial volume for its standpoint, and each has a determinate location relative to all others. Mentality itself is not spatial.

sources.quote: every actual entity in the temporal world is to be credited with a spatial volume for its perspective standpoint
In Whitehead’s system every actual occasion has a determinate spatiotemporal location relative to all others
